name: Envy
source:
Stripped of their name and shunned after committing treason, the Sovereign now known as Lord Envy lives a life of solitude and confinement. Will you be able to break down the walls they have built around themselves for centuries, or will you remain a prisoner in his castle for all eternity?

[From [url=https://ravenstar-games.itch.io/lost-in-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
